description: 부산광역시_하천 수질(수질측정망) 정보 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 부산광역시. 수영강, 동부산, 서낙동강, 중부산 등 5개 권역의 감전천, 괴정천, 남천, 대리천, 대천천, 동천, 삼락천, 석대천, 동백천, 송정천, 학장천, 신어천, 춘천, 부산천 등 32개 하천에. Coverage: 부산광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 부산광역시. Its tags are 오염, 강물, 환경, 대장균, 수온. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
